title.value: Do Neural Dialog Systems Use the Conversation History Effectively? An Empirical Study
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper and is reiterated in the abstract, summarizing the main focus of the research.
title.quote: Do Neural Dialog Systems Use the Conversation History Effectively? An Empirical Study

analysis.description: The paper investigates how neural generative models, specifically recurrent and transformer-based sequence-to-sequence models, utilize available dialog history. By subjecting these models to various artificial perturbations in dialog histories during testing, it finds that these models are often insensitive to changes suggesting minimal exploitation of dialog history.

type.justification: The study involves empirical observations of model behavior in response to artificial perturbations in dialog history, thus classifying it as an empirical study.
type.quote: In this work, we take an empirical approach to understanding how these models use the available dialog history by studying the sensitivity of the models to artificially introduced unnatural changes or perturbations to their context at test time.
